title: Escanor vs Galand — 80s Live Action | Seven Deadly Sins
description:
Escanor vs Galand, reimagined in 80s live action.

What if The Seven Deadly Sins were a live-action fantasy movie from the 1980s? This fan-made recreation brings the confrontation to life with realistic characters, vintage film texture, and a retro CRT-inspired look.

A familiar anime scene through the lens of an old-school fantasy film.

Created using AI as an unofficial fan tribute. This is not an official adaptation or trailer.

Which Seven Deadly Sins scene would you like to see in this style next?

Song: Escanor Theme
Cover by Edziovsky

#SevenDeadlySins #Escanor #LiveAction
